cycles.trigger: Carried the payroll-skill wage/figure audit across; the new --check-sources gate flagged 39 of 44 evidence snippets as absent from their cited URLs.
lessons: KEY FINDING: the 2026 figures were all CORRECT. Every January-indexed ceiling (13,769 average wage, 15,712 / 18,854 hishtalmut, 13,203 / 20,566 / 293,397 self-employed, 9,430 kitzbah mezakah, 57.5% exemption, 5,422 exempt, 5,306 Tikun 190 threshold, 0.22%/1% default fees) verified against source. The unanchored evidence was NOT hiding wrong numbers here.

CORRECTNESS BUG FIXED: Tikun 190 was described as 15% on the REAL (CPI-adjusted) gain benchmarked against a 47% marginal rate. It is 15% on the NOMINAL gain, benchmarked against 25% real. This both misstated the rule and oversold the benefit; in a high-inflation stretch nominal-basis 15% can exceed real-basis 25%. It had propagated to 7 places across 4 files.

CORRECTNESS BUG FIXED: three distinct ceilings were merged into one. The mandatory-pension insurable ceiling is the average wage (13,769), NOT twice it (27,538). 27,538 is the salary implied by the tax-favoured deposit ceiling; 41,307 (3x average wage) is the fund's maximum determining salary.

DEBT (33 entries): the remaining pre-existing snippets are self-authored Hebrew SUMMARIES in a 'label: value' style rather than quotations, e.g. 'תקרת קצבה מזכה 2026: 9,430 ש"ח/חודש'. Structurally indistinguishable from fabrication. 13 were re-anchored to real verbatim quotes this cycle; the rest remain.

SOURCE NOTE: btl.gov.il/About/news/…hadasaidkonkitzva2026.aspx now 404s despite still ranking in search. Live amounts are at /benefits/old_age/Shum/Pages/Shum.aspx and /Tosafot.aspx. malam-payroll's 2026 update page carries the ceilings in IMAGES only. The Harel 2026 ceilings PDF is the richest text-layer source, but percent signs extract as the letter B via pdftotext.

DEFERRED: the investment-track reform (target-date tracks 'יעד לפרישה 2030' through '2070') is not mentioned anywhere in the skill and was not verified to a primary CMA circular. Verify and add next cycle.
WATCH: exemption rate steps to 62.5% in 2027 and 67% in 2028 (skill states these correctly); women's retirement age advances to 63 and 6 months for the 1964 cohort.

STALE fix: Tikun 190 minimum qualifying-pension (kitzbah mezakah) threshold was the ~2024/2025 value 5,012 shekel; the 2026 CPI-bumped value is 5,306 shekel. Updated in 7 spots (SKILL.md Step 7 + Example 4, SKILL_HE mirrors, references/tax-benefits.md, references/pension-fund-types.md, evidence.json). Example 4's conclusion (8,000 > threshold) was unaffected. This threshold CPI-bumps yearly, re-verify each cycle via pensuni 2026 table.

VERIFIED OK for 2026 (no change, impressively well-maintained): average wage 13,769, mandatory rates 6%/6.5%/6%(8.33%), comprehensive-fund deposit ceiling 5,645.29 (salary base 27,538), kitzbah mezakah ceiling 9,430, pension exemption 57.5% + tax-free 5,422, severance exempt 13,750/yr, keren hishtalmut cap 15,712, self-employed hishtalmut 13,203/20,566, employee pension credit qualifying salary 9,700, self-employed pension benefits 38,412 combined / 232,800 ceiling, self-employed mandatory brackets (4.45%/12.55%, ~14,044 max), IRA cap 83,641. The skill correctly does NOT conflate the several distinct pension ceilings (a real strength).

CRITICAL fix (expert-found, pre-existing): the lifetime tax-exempt capital pool (kibua zechuyot / yitrat hahon haptura) was given as '32 years × 180% × kitzbah mezakah ≈ 1.5M NIS' in SKILL.md, SKILL_HE.md, references/tax-benefits.md. That mangles the formula (conflates the 32-year heichum lookback window with the fixed coefficient 180, writes 180% instead of 180, drops the exemption rate) AND overstates the pool by ~50%. Correct: pool = 180 × the monthly tax-exempt pension = 180 × (57.5% × 9,430) = 180 × 5,422 ≈ 976,000 NIS for 2026 (grows toward 67% rate by 2028). Fixed in all 3 files. A retiree trusting the inflated 1.5M would over-withdraw tax-exempt severance and erode the exemption.

CARRY (MINOR, expert): the 5,306 Tikun-190 eligibility threshold is labelled 'kitzbah mezakah minimum' but the legally precise term is 'kitzbah mizirit' (קצבה מזערית / minimum pension), distinct from the 'kitzbah mezakah' qualifying ceiling (9,430). Number and guidance are correct; rename for precision next cycle.

CARRY (FYI, not cited as numbers so nothing stale): nekudat zikui monthly value (~242 in 2026) and income-tax-bracket/surtax thresholds are referenced only generically; if specific numbers are ever added, they CPI-bump annually and the 2025 expanded surtax on capital income would need noting.
